verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is a support-site heading saying recruiters can schedule events and sync their work calendar. That is recruiter-side calendar sync, not candidate self-scheduling through booking links tied to the team's live availability, so it counts only as an adjacent feature. Nothing in the pack documents candidate-facing booking links, self-scheduling or timezone handling.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains

citations.quote: Schedule events and sync your work calendar
